statements.impact_statement: Exact sqlite-libs 3.34.1-11.el9_8 RPM version and architecture in Keycloak 26.8.2 only. CVE-2026-119586 affects the SQLite command-line shell .recover command; the affected shell implementation is not part of sqlite-libs. Both platform inventories show the sqlite3 executable is absent and only shared-library files are installed. On ARM64 nss-softokn declares a dependency on sqlite-libs, so this statement does not claim that the library is unused; it is limited solely to the CLI .recover vulnerability. This statement is loaded only by trivy-keycloak.yaml for the Keycloak 26.8.2 multi-architecture scan. It does not cover the CLI package, other products or CVE-2026-119373 affecting FTS5 in sqlite-libs, which remains open.
